method.executor: Formal departure and recovery dispatch frozen v1/v2 executor; selector uses current generated CSV configuration.
method.isolation: Sequential workers. Every generation and every cold restore gets its own fresh Node process; serialized identity passes over stdin.
method.elapsedMs: Measured after module import; departure includes selector, generation and signature. Restore includes validation/signature. Worker wall time separately includes Node/TSX startup and fingerprint checks.
method.quantiles: Nearest-rank empirical sample quantiles. 32 natural seeds are not sufficient to estimate population p99.
method.failurePolicy: No replacement/resampling on failure. Preserve per-case errors and timeouts. Historical/directed cases never enter the natural denominator.

limitations: Node CPU/heap baseline, not browser frame timing, GPU memory, mobile/lower-spec qualification, or natural player experience.
Concurrent developer activity can affect timings. CPU load recorded; no claims of isolated lab measurement.
No warm-process JIT generation measurement; warm restore explicitly measures an existing cache, not regeneration.
Existing legacy worlds only; zero R100 world–pollution-grade qualification cells inferred.
